card.name: Zero in 2000s years
card.fires_on: The digit 0 right after a leading 2 when a year in the 2000s is being written, as in 2006, 2001 or 2003. It appears in dates, citations and history text.

modes.label: Year after 'in'
modes.description: The 0 in a 200x year following a word like in, since or during.

modes.label: Year in citations
modes.description: The 0 in a 200x year in a reference entry.

card.writes: It seems to push the next digits of a year to follow the 0, and it suppresses odd number words and Chinese tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the zero in a year such as 2001 or 2006, right after the 2.
